# note { #crossrepo.cli.note }

```python
crossrepo.cli.note(version)
```

Summarise what is unusual about a version, for the table's NOTE column.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**version**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Version to describe.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Its tags, whether it is held in Git LFS or published as a symbolic link, and how many parts it has if it is a dataset, comma separated; empty for an ordinary tagless file.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
note(entry.latest)
# 'v1.0,12 parts'
```
